item.title: Little blue heron strolling past great egret at the Olympia Recreation Center
item.description: A little blue heron strolls past the great egret, pretending not to notice the impressive catch. Just the same, he hangs around hoping that the great egret's luck passes onto him at a pond near the Olympia Recreation Center in Eastport. Thanks to Julie Walfield for sharing! Read more: Little blue heron strolling past great egret at the Olympia Recreation Center
